channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: What type of fruit can fix your sink?
item.description:
What type of fruit can fix your sink?
A plum-ber!

item.title: Why were the strawberries so upset?
item.description:
Why were the strawberries so upset?
Because they were in a jam!

item.title: What do you get when two peas fight?
item.description:
What do you get when two peas fight?
Black-eyed peas!

item.title: Why aren't grapes ever lonely?
item.description:
Why aren't grapes ever lonely?
Because they come in bunches!

item.title: Why did the boy bring a fork to math class?
item.description:
Why did the boy bring a fork to math class?
He heard there was going to be pi.

item.title: What kind of trees come in two's?
item.description:
What kind of trees come in two's?
Pear trees.

item.title: Why did Mickey Mouse go to space?
item.description:
Why did Mickey Mouse go to space?
To find Pluto.

item.title: What do you call a robot that always takes the longest route?
item.description:
What do you call a robot that always takes the longest route?
R2 detour!

item.title: Why did the alien throw beef on the asteroid?
item.description:
Why did the alien throw beef on the asteroid?
He wanted it a little meteor!

item.title: What do you do when you see a spaceman?
item.description:
What do you do when you see a spaceman?
Park in it!
